## Current Outcome

NextGen Wargame now follows the approved site boundary:

- `taijeronv.info` owns the person, complete biography, and general AI conversation.
- `nextgenwargame.com` owns the military-training domain, systems, evidence, and publication layer.

The redesign adapts the licensed Arcbes 1.0.1 template into the existing Astro application. Existing content collections, project URLs, decision records, and Field Notes were preserved rather than replacing the application with the template.

## Approved Work

The operator visually reviewed and approved:

1. Homepage direction.
2. Systems index direction.
3. System case-study and decision-record direction.

The following editorial slice is implemented and awaiting manual visual approval:

1. Founder-focused About page.
2. Redesigned CADE Field Notes index and article layout.
3. Restored AI Workbench index and eight article routes.

## Implemented Changes

### Shared foundation

- Replaced personal sidebar with responsive NextGen Wargame header.
- Added Arcbes-derived Urbanist typography and operational light palette.
- Updated footer, favicon declarations, site description, navigation, and shared layout.
- Added `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` with Arcbes MIT attribution.
- Changed SEO title ownership from TJ to `NextGen Wargame`.
- Removed references to nonexistent default social images and search routes from SEO/schema output.

### Homepage

- Leads with `Decision training` and `Built for teams under pressure`.
- Presents live-use evidence before personal biography.
- Connects CADE, Orders Production, and Controller Package Generator.
- Explains human design authority and governed AI production.
- Includes Field Notes and military-training-problem calls to action.

### Systems and case studies

- `/projects/` now presents the three products as one operating stack.
- All system overview pages use the approved wide editorial hierarchy.
- All decision pages use a shared decision-record presentation.
- Labels now use `Systems`, `System overview`, and `Decision record` where appropriate.

### About and editorial sections

- `/about/` contains only NextGen-relevant founder credibility.
- Complete personal biography is handed off to `https://taijeronv.info`.
- `/field-notes/` remains the CADE narrative and execution-learning lane.
- `/model-workbench/` remains the AI-specific methods, models, tooling, verification, and maintenance lane.
- Workbench is now directly discoverable through desktop and mobile navigation.

## Working-Tree Warning

The repository was already dirty before redesign work began. Preserve unrelated user files and changes.

Known unrelated state includes:

- Deleted `docs/content-creator/creator-brief-cade_v1.0_DFT.md`.
- Untracked document exports and design/campaign folders.
- `.DS_Store`, `.superpowers/`, and other preexisting untracked material.

Do not use destructive reset or broad cleanup. When committing, stage redesign files explicitly rather than using `git add -A`.
